scope: Historical margin diagnostics and next weighting experiment; not full Senate-seat readiness
older_history_role: Earlier training cycles for priors and tuning; separate older-period and all-history sensitivities
temporal_weighting: Not chosen; no age-based deletion or arbitrary decay introduced
poll_policy: Existing checked_reason and select_one_per_poll in notebook Section10
unknown_estimate_basis: retain unknown; no automatic full/decided conversion
source_inconsistency: retain flagged baseline and report source-justified alternate/omission sensitivity
missing_n: retain for equal-poll averages; never invent or sum as known N
shared_samples: one selected estimate per sample_group_id within contest; unresolved cross-poll overlap remains a limitation
other_outcomes: retain existing result status and unresolved election-rule exclusions
reference_denominator: all reported candidate and unallocated write-in votes; exclude nonvotes and duplicate round summaries
availability: known publication dates must respect cutoff; missing publication dates yield approximate field-date-only retrospective analysis
weight_formula_next: firm total weight proportional to m^alpha, divided equally among its m selected polls
evaluation: expanding training cycles strictly before target cycle; primary reporting 2016-2024; older and all-history results separately; presidential/midterm separated
evaluation_status: retrospective after exploratory review, not untouched test data
